answer_1.quote: We frame this as a text-to-text generation task.
answer_1.outputs: Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) and task predictions (e.g., contradiction, answer choice) are generated simultaneously in a self-rationalization setup.

answer_2.quote: We employ automatic evaluation metrics SacreBLEU and BERTScore to capture both lexical and semantic similarity.

answer_4.quote: We engaged three PhD students with backgrounds in computer science to evaluate the explanations using a 1-7 Likert scale following previous work.
answer_4.guideline: The annotator agreement is reported in Table. Note that we randomly sample 100 NLEs generated by each model.
